STANDS WITH THE LOCALE'S OWN DEBT, not beside it: this locale carries no catalogue BY DESIGN (the package ships six active locales — tests/unit/i18n/test_package_data.py — and zh-CN is security-held), so the new namespace's bytes cannot exist here. The owner and payoff are the standing debt's own, because a per-namespace debt cannot be paid off before the locale's.
